verdict.rationale: Gide's public pages are mostly practice-area marketing describing services from fundraising to exit. The only explainer-style content in evidence is a single published insight on BSPCE founder-warrant taxation under the 2026 finance law, listed on the Executives & Management Packages page. That is one thin, glancing piece of public equity content, not an organised startup knowledge base. Missing for 10: a structured, open startup knowledge base or hub; plain-language guides or FAQs on company formation and financing; broader equity explainers beyond one tax insight; and any independent or hands-on confirmation of founder-oriented educational content.
